skill.summary: Build a sufficient automated test suite before refactoring existing code by applying a 6-step sequential construction workflow (test class → fixture → normal...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – provides a step-by-step workflow for building automated test suites before refactoring.

- Guides users through creating a test file, setting up fixtures, and covering normal behavior, boundaries, and error conditions.
- Describes a "green-suite gate" to ensure all tests pass before any refactoring begins.
- Includes a bug-fix variant workflow (failing test → reproduce → fix → verify).
- Lists assessment and sufficiency guidelines for existing codebases.
- Designed primarily for developers preparing code for safe, reversible refactoring.
